channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Yield on 10-year Treasury hovers above 5% as investors await Fed decision
item.description: The Federal Reserve is widely expected to hike interest rates on Wednesday.

item.title: Canada invited to become EU’s first ‘associate member’ as Trump trade war intensifies
item.description: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.

item.title: Intel, SK Hynix shares jump on report they're discussing U.S. memory chip manufacturing
item.description: The deal could be a big win for Intel which has been looking to gain marquee customers for its manufacturing, or foundry, business.

item.title: Mortgage demand from homebuyers drops 19% from a year ago, as interest rates surge abruptly higher
item.description: Mortgage rates have surged to the highest level since the start of 2025, causing a major pullback in mortgage demand.

item.title: Budweiser's parent is a buy thanks to its strong presence in emerging markets, says Deutsche Bank
item.description: The investment bank upgraded AB InBev to buy from hold.

item.title: Saudi says Houthis targeted Mecca with a drone, Iran-backed group rejects claim
item.description: The Organization of Islamic Cooperation condemned the strike as a "heinous" attack. Mecca is Islam's holiest site and the focal point of the annual Hajj pilgrimage.

item.title: Oil falls as U.S. crude inventories reportedly rise, traders weigh Saudi pipeline closure
item.description: Oil fell Wednesday, as an unexpected increase in U.S. crude inventories outweighed worries over supply disruptions after an Iran-backed attack on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline.

item.title: AWS says it can't restore service to Bahrain, UAE facilities 6 months after Iran strikes
item.description: In March, two Amazon data centers in the UAE were struck by drones, while a site was also damaged by a nearby drone hit.

item.title: Trump says Kennedy Center will stay closed without renovation unless his name is added back
item.description: The ruling comes four months after the same judge ordered that the Kennedy Center could not be renamed to include President Trump's name.

item.title: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg sides with Nvidia's Huang on AI safety and slowdown debate
item.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's view of artificial intelligence safety is akin to the perspective of Nvidia's Jensen Huang rather than Anthropic chief Dario Amodei.

item.title: Ford increases V-8 engine availability, lowers performance prices for 2027 F-150 trucks
item.description: Ford said the changes are meant to provide customers with more choice and help expand sales of key models, a strategy CEO Jim Farley has touted.

item.title: Americans' incomes rose and poverty fell in 2025, Census Bureau says
item.description: The data comes as the Federal Reserve is considering interest-rate increases that could slow economic growth.

item.title: Flyers are happier with U.S. airports, despite near record travel levels, J.D. Power report shows
item.description: Travelers gave higher ratings in part because of the newer gates and terminals many airports have opened in recent years, according to the study.

item.title: Senate cloture vote on Clarity Act fails, dealing regulatory blow to crypto industry
item.description: The Senate on Tuesday voted to block the Clarity Act from advancing, dealing a blow to the crypto industry's push for a comprehensive market framework.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Huang attending Trump's state dinner for China's Xi: Source
item.description: Jensen Huang appeared to side with Trump as the president pushed back on tech CEOs' warnings about the risks of rapid AI advancement.

item.title: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar tells CNBC she isn't worried about slowing AI development
item.description: Friar joined CNBC's Jim Cramer on "Mad Money" as the debate over technology's safety risks rages on.

item.title: Iran war has cost on average $246 million per day in its first five months, CBO finds
item.description: CBO estimates the Iran war cost the Pentagon $38.1 billion through Aug. 1 and could cost another $2 billion to $3 billion each additional month.

item.title: Ukraine's message to Asian nations: your chips are turning up in Russian missiles
item.description: Ukraine's sanctions envoy said Russia could be forced to retreat from the war within six months if its oil revenues are halved.

item.title: Dovish outlier Nomura boosted Fed-hike forecasts for two reasons
item.description: Elevated oil prices and sticky inflation have prompted Nomura to add more rate hikes to its monetary forecasts, though less than what the market is pricing.

item.title: Why de-dollarization discussions are more talk, less action
item.description: BRICS leaders have asserted the need to use local currencies in intra-BRICS trade to cut dependency on dollar.

item.title: Wells Fargo sees improvement in a key metric — plus, Lilly gets praise beyond GLP-1s
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: I tested AI to save money on travel. Here’s what actually worked — and the tools I recommend
item.description: I found AI-powered tools work best for price tracking and efficiently planning your trip.

item.title: China's AI leaders keep quiet despite U.S. 'publicity' on tech risks
item.description: Z.ai, Moonshot, MiniMax, Alibaba and Tencent did not provide any statements when contacted by CNBC about the warnings on AI from Silicon Valley.

item.title: Trump Account contributions have a Dec. 31 deadline — and employers can complicate the math
item.description: Employers can offer Trump Account employee benefits via direct contributions or by allowing workers to make pre-tax contributions to a child's account.

item.title: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic discussing collaboration on AI safety issues
item.description: Discussions have been ongoing since Google's Demis Hassabis released a proposal in July calling for a U.S.-led "Standards Body," the spokesperson said.

item.title: Nvidia's Huang diverges with CEOs of Anthropic, OpenAI on AI safety at Dreamforce
item.description: Comments from the two tech leaders landed days after Anthropic's Dario Amodei published an essay urging the AI industry to slow the pace of model development.

item.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.1% as energy costs soar
item.description: The reading comes a day before the Bank of England updates its monetary policy.

item.title: Crypto exchange Binance takes on tradfi by courting rich investors to join its expanded wealth-management platform
item.description: Binance is opening its Capital Connect platform to qualified individual investors for the first time.

item.title: BOJ expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to fresh three-decade high: CNBC survey
item.description: The BOJ is expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to a fresh three-decade high, a CNBC survey shows.

item.title: Grab aims for 'next level' in financial services with purchase of buy-now pay-later platform Atome
item.description: Grab is betting $1.49 billion on Atome Financial as it looks to expand its consumer lending business in Southeast Asia.
